remediation_changes.reason: Owner-reported failures reproduced by the remediation audit of 2026-10-05: cramped UI and doubled player, no automatic recording timing, lecture and slide questions not visible, no concept views or separated evidence, tutoring policy withheld whole.
remediation_changes.rule: Carried by existing tasks; task ids, stories, flows, workflows and original release gates are unchanged. Prior LOCAL_TESTED results of the affected tasks do not cover the listed checks.
remediation_changes.check_definitions: docs/features/*/requirements.md and test-plan.md, sections 'Remediation amendment R1'

remediation_changes.reason: The learner tested the build of amendment R1 and rejects its visual design; usable slide-to-recording ranges, question-to-slide links and discoverable course/lecture/slide concept maps are still not obtainable. Owner instruction of 2026-10-05 (PROMPTS/EXPERIENCE_REPAIR_V2.md).
remediation_changes.rule: Carried by existing tasks; task ids, stories, flows, workflows and original release gates are unchanged. The affected requirements are REOPENED as open product failures despite green receipts: prior LOCAL_TESTED results and R1 receipts of the affected tasks do not cover the listed checks, and a passing mechanical test alone closes none of them. Every check is falsifiable by an outcome the learner would notice.
supersedes_in_R1: The R1 'direction B' look (the three-region arrangement is kept; its visual treatment is rejected by the learner).
R1-U1 clause 'card collections at least 80% of the width': a share of the window is not a success criterion, and neither is a 1152 px cap.
The four-tab context panel (Tutor, Transcript, This slide, Questions): replaced by Tutor, Questions, Concepts, Transcript, Sources in a resizable panel.
'No slide named in the course record' as an end state for a question: replaced by explicit anchor states including inferred candidates.
The concept outline being reachable in ordinary navigation only from Progress: replaced by Concept map in the course header and a Concepts tab in the lecture workspace.
The single 'no timing for this slide' line: replaced by six distinct states.
R1 not_in_scope item 'speech recognition runs': offline CPU transcription is in scope within the persisted four-hour allowance.
Decision D46 (no graph library): replaced by decision D61.

changes: Every check that is not an evidence item has one on-screen verification row in its test plan; a unit, projection or command test alone closes none (decision D73).
Graph labels (R2-C3) and the type census (R2-V7) are measured as rendered.
The inferred-anchor contract is the fixed private format ll.inferred-anchors/1 (decision D74).
The This-slide concept scope says on which build an entry is supported (R2-C2).
A sixth no-range state, 'not matched yet' (R2-T9, decision D75).
No relative or window-share criterion in R2-V6 and R2-V8; transport bar and range list told apart (decision D76).
Every check names stories, flows and workflows, each owned by a task that carries the check; carrying tasks were added where needed.

R2-V1.summary: Lecture workspace: collapsible outline, large original-source canvas (stage at least half of the workspace at default pane sizes on the three desktop sizes), one context panel.

R2-V2.summary: ONE compact media control system on the lecture page whichever tab is open: one play/pause, one timeline, one time readout, with the selected range and scope. The transport bar is at most 128 CSS px tall on desktop; a slide's several ranges are a range list opened from the bar, which never grows it.

R2-V3.summary: Resizable context panel (drag and keyboard, bounded, width remembered) with five text-labelled tabs in order: Tutor, Questions, Concepts, Transcript, Sources.

R2-V4.summary: Narrow screens (390x844, 768x1024): one focused pane at a time from an explicit pane control, transport reachable from every pane, no sideways scroll.

R2-V5.summary: Study home leads with Resume, then course and lecture browsing with real titles and thumbnails; no invented progress, dates, facts or charts.

R2-V6.summary: Separate appearance decisions for home (deliberate centred browsing measure) and reading views (laid out for the slide); prose lines at most 80 characters; no width cap and no share of the window is a criterion or is asserted by a test.

R2-V7.summary: Reading text 16-18 px with line height at least 1.45; restrained 12-14 px metadata (at most a tenth of visible characters below 14 px); one declared type and spacing scale, at most seven sizes per screen; sizes measured as rendered; only text inside a source rendering is left out.

R2-V8.summary: Reading content in at most one bordered container; pills only for a state, a filter or an actionable source reference; distinct default, hover, focus and selected states, selection not by colour alone; rendered contrast for text, accent, focus ring and selected states; no criterion relative to the R1 build.

R2-V9.summary: Slide keeps original colours in both themes; draft, playback position, selected range, slide, tab and panel width survive theme, outline, resize, tab and pane changes; reduced motion honoured.

R2-V10.summary: Acceptance needs BOTH measured checks AND a recorded independent visual critique against the two approved references at 1440x900, 1920x1080, 2560x1440, tablet and phone in both themes; designer-reviewed is not user-approved.

R2-S1.summary: ONE versioned read-side source map per deck version is the only source of slide identity for navigation, transcript, player, questions, Concepts and search.

R2-S2.summary: Identity kinds stay distinct: source id/version/hash; physical PDF page index (explicit base) and optional page label; printed slide number only if established; PPTX slide id and ordinal only when a PPTX exists; logical-slide identity with evidence and revision; build variant or region; recording occurrence.

R2-S3.summary: Build/reveal sequences become one logical slide only on several signals; every build stays addressable; content revealed later is not attributed to an earlier build.

R2-S4.summary: No false merges: look-alike pages are not merged, uncertain pages stay separately addressable, an adjacent repeat is a duplicate and never a build, multi-slide handout pages expose each region, nothing leaves the page inventory.

R2-S5.summary: Group, split and role corrections are versioned local annotations that survive rebuilds; old deep links keep opening the same physical page of the same source version.

R2-S6.summary: Visible wording states only what is known: 'PDF page 23 of 91 - build 2 of 3'; 'Slide 17' only when a number is printed on that page or the source map records a PowerPoint match for that page.

R2-S7.summary: Content role of every page (instructional, worked example/question, objectives/summary, structural title/section, administrative, blank, mixed, unknown) classified separately, with evidence and state, and correctable.

R2-S8.summary: Structural pages get no forced teach-back, generated practice, concept requirement or missing-match warning; they offer Next content and whole-lecture access; supported speech over a title stays discoverable.

R2-S9.summary: Image-only and equation-only pages are never suppressed, skipped or classified structural or blank because their text is sparse.

R2-S10.summary: Raw and instructional denominators are reported separately with the counts of the other roles adding up to the page count; re-labelling changes no page's own state and never the raw figure; the instructional figure is always shown beside the raw one with the count of pages outside it and how their roles were established.

R2-S11.summary: A replaced or reordered deck gets a new source-map revision; links and anchors of the old version are flagged for review, never silently retargeted.

R2-T1.summary: The existing timing proof is imported through the tested importer (consumer-side adapter; hashes and source/version binding checked; producer untouched; no duplicate recognition) and shown for its own window only.

R2-T2.summary: Resumable offline transcription (one worker, at most four threads, bounded checkpointed chunks) under a four-hour cumulative allowance persisted across restarts and never reset; safe pause with the queue kept; the proposed downstream task bound to the same runner as a prepared, inactive record.

R2-T3.summary: Chunk edges are correct: offsets applied once, overlapping seams de-duplicated, silence and partial chunks handled, no time outside the original recording.

R2-T4.summary: Generated words are kept separate from the original transcript; times reach original lines only through a validated text-alignment mapping; unaligned lines carry no time.

R2-T5.summary: Candidate scoring over time windows and logical slides with a sequence model permitting skips, repeats, backward jumps and unassigned intervals.

R2-T6.summary: The association method is benchmarked against the lexical baseline on the same labelled references with thresholds fixed beforehand; a missing adequate method is stated, not certified.

R2-T7.summary: A timing link binds recording version, timebase, start/end, logical slide, optional page/build support, method, evidence and quality state; acoustic, semantic and group-mapping quality are separate; 'displayed' only where video frames were visible and inspected.

R2-T8.summary: Disjoint occurrences stay separate links; time is never distributed evenly over slides; group-level links are labelled and not split into per-build ranges.

R2-T9.summary: Six distinct no-range states, each from its own cause: not discussed, audio not processed, not matched yet, ambiguous, recording unavailable, structural page with no range expected; structural pages are still matched.

R2-T10.summary: Suggestions are rendered and labelled with their method without confirmation of each; never shown as confirmed; reviewed and manual links survive rebuilds; a suggestion built from superseded inputs is not shown as current; start-end times shown.

R2-T11.summary: Selecting a match seeks the real player to its start and playback stops at its end unless Repeat or Whole recording is chosen.

R2-T12.summary: Per-course stage, coverage and backlog for every admitted recording and deck, with unresolved causes, and one resumable command; no schedule.

R2-T13.summary: One complete real lecture is the end-to-end reference, including content beyond the opening; a reference, not a scope limit and not an accuracy claim.

R2-Q1.summary: Every catalogued question stays reachable (bank, lecture list, search), including null-prompt questions with their source-opening actions; totals reconcile catalog to rendered list at run time.

R2-Q2.summary: Authoritative criteria, concepts and skills are joined to the page / logical-slide map; reviewed anchors first, matched by physical page.

R2-Q3.summary: Separately INFERRED candidate anchors for coarse or unmapped questions in the fixed private format, each with supporting page(s)/region(s), question version, supported criteria and rationale, rendered on the question's card as a suggested link; 'no slide named' is not an end state.

R2-Q4.summary: Inference guards: shared vocabulary alone is insufficient; a link names the criteria it supports and never claims the whole answer; nothing inferred from problem-set numbering; no prompt, weight or figure requirement invented; an unchecked candidate says so and a rejected one is never shown as a link.

R2-Q5.summary: Exact source maps, agent-inferred associations and concept-related questions are distinct, distinctly labelled kinds; no rebuild promotes one into another.

R2-Q6.summary: This slide, Related concepts and All lecture questions with counts equal to their rows and to the catalog; in a build group each row says 'on this build', 'elsewhere in this sequence' or 'group-level'.

R2-Q7.summary: Clickable source-page/build links on question cards open the exact source version and page and preserve the draft; Back returns.

R2-Q8.summary: Structural pages have no forced This-slide questions; the lecture's questions stay reachable from them.

R2-Q9.summary: The three real examples named in the owner instruction validate privately: reviewed physical-page map honoured, the pilot's page not reused without audit, source-owned wording with justified related slides and no invented requirement.

R2-Q10.summary: Assessor guidance stays out of every question-only payload and out of inferred-anchor rationales.

R2-C1.summary: Explicit Concept map access in every course header and a Concepts tab in the lecture workspace, reachable by ordinary navigation from Study.

R2-C2.summary: One scope control - Course, Lecture, This slide - that changes the visible set and states scope and counts; inside a build group each entry says whether it is on this build, elsewhere in the sequence or group-level.

R2-C3.summary: A readable hierarchy AND a graph neighbourhood view from one layout engine: topic-level grouping, expand on demand, selection retained, labels at least 12 px as rendered after the graph's own zoom; never all nodes at once.

R2-C4.summary: A keyboard-usable outline alternative offering the same nodes, relations, expansion, selection and detail as the graph.

R2-C5.summary: One typed read model for all three scopes and both presentations; same ids and counts; no second graph store.

R2-C6.summary: Three edge families stay distinct in data and on screen: question to criterion to concept/skill; source; prerequisite/overlap.

R2-C7.summary: Selecting a node opens Sources, Questions and Evidence following actual joins; sources open the exact page/build; missing definitions are explicit gaps.

R2-C8.summary: Build grouping never duplicates concepts, questions or performances; counts do not multiply with builds.

R2-C9.summary: Five different evidence states: unknown, not applicable, not separately observed, assisted, independent; prior exposure alone is not assistance.

R2-C10.summary: No mastery or probability; percentages only with explicit unique denominators and conditions; coarse stays coarse; structural pages have no forced assessed concept branch.

R2-C11.summary: Revision-based invalidation: a new source, changed build group or changed anchor refreshes only the affected Course/Lecture/Slide views, keeps corrections, alters no attempt; stale views say so.

R2-B1.summary: The app states its identity as readable text in Settings (commit, loaded asset names, Brain profile and port, per-course preparation generation and source-map revision); the status interface reports the same.

R2-B2.summary: A stale page is detected and said: loaded assets that do not belong to the served build produce one line with Reload; no silent cache of an old shell.

R2-B3.summary: The data in view is identified: synthetic sample data says so on Study; an unresolved or empty scope shows an explained state with a way back.

R2-E1.summary: Evidence item 1: build, profile, asset and generation identity of the exact preview tested, equal to what the page shows; another port is not evidence about the learner's instance.

R2-E2.summary: Evidence item 2: before/after Study, Lecture and Concept captures in both themes at the desktop sizes and mobile, inspected for real content and reference fidelity.

R2-E3.summary: Evidence item 3: visible end-to-end journey by ordinary navigation: Study, substantive logical slide, actual recording range, relevant question, supporting PDF page/build, connected concept, evidence panel, return with state preserved.

R2-E4.summary: Evidence item 4: original-media seeked/currentTime observations at three or more real ranges beyond the opening plus bounded-end and Repeat checks; mechanical only; acoustic QA pending unless someone listened.

R2-E5.summary: Evidence item 5: logical-slide/page reconciliation table and tests for builds, false merges, numbering offsets, multi-slide handouts, source replacement, manual splits and group-level timing; synthetic cases labelled.

R2-E6.summary: Evidence item 6: role-classification negatives (image/equation-only retained; plain cover not assessed; speech over a title discoverable); raw and instructional denominators reported separately.

R2-E7.summary: Evidence item 7: direct/related/lecture question counts with actual click paths; scoped graph changes; no duplicate or invented learning evidence.

R2-E8.summary: Evidence item 8: stage coverage for every admitted recording and deck with unresolved causes and measured limitations; generated, agent-reviewed and human-confirmed counted separately.

R2-E9.summary: Evidence item 9: restart, idempotency, stale-input and revision tests, focused regressions, and one final integrated zero-retry run on the final code.

in_scope: read-only inspection of configured course sources, catalogs and policies
import of the existing timing proof through the tested importer

offline CPU transcription with the verified local runtime: one worker, at most four threads, resumable bounded chunks, four hours cumulative processing wall time persisted across restarts and never reset
local derived links displayed as attributable suggestions
real browser tests on an owned loopback instance
not_in_scope: native or tutor sends, pilot renewal
course, catalog, attempt, shared-mapping, grade or planner writes
schedule activation, public ports, deployment, OAuth, Office automation
model downloads, GPU or system installs, global environment changes, paid inference
claims of user aesthetic approval or of validated educational accuracy
